g.text: Why the baseline is the whole argument. Against Thursday and Saturday the Korean cohort reads 1.93x; against five weekdays it reads 1.06x, the same as the US semiconductors.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; fill: #565660

g.text: SKHX quotes exactly 0.825 bps in 18 of its 20 Saturday hours and SMSN exactly 0.519 bps in 18 of 20, just 3 and 3 distinct values in a whole day, against 24 in 24

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; fill: #565660

g.text: on every other contract-day here, while their depth rises 27x. A frozen weekend book halves their baseline and invents a widening that five clean sessions show is not there.
